During the [[Galactic Civil War]], and shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sent [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[R2-D2]] on a '''mission''' to the [[planet]] [[Rodia]]. The goal of the mission was for Skywalker to open a secret [[Smuggler|smuggling]] supply line for the Rebel Alliance. The [[Chekkoo clan]], which made weapons and armaments, was a rival of the ruling [[Chattza clan]], which was allied closely with the [[Galactic Empire]]. [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Princess Leia]] thought that the Chekkoo clan might be willing to help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] in order to overthrow the Chattza clan.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />
